items.statement: The investigation independently constructs one pristine ordered B2 beta-NiAl reference and separate neutral Ni- and Al-vacancy states with explicit identity checks.
items.expected: The report identifies both removed sublattices, atom counts, charge and reservoir convention without relying on an author-route hint.

items.statement: The investigation supplies reproducibility evidence through convergence or sensitivity and transparent formation-energy bookkeeping.
items.expected: Dominant numerical choices and their stability/sensitivity are reported, with an explicit equation and total energies.

items.statement: The reported neutral Ni-vacancy formation energy is approximately 0.98 eV.
items.expected: Ni-vacancy formation energy is 0.98 eV within tolerance.

items.statement: The reported neutral Al-vacancy formation energy is approximately 1.20 eV.
items.expected: Al-vacancy formation energy is 1.20 eV within tolerance.
